useCase: Detecting geometric inconsistencias and impossible perspectivas in generado por IA architectural/scene images
mechanism: Detecta straight lines using Hough Transform and estimates vanishing points from line intersections. Verifica geometric consistency by checking that parallel lines in 3D converge to consistent vanishing points. generado por IA scenes often violate projective geometry rules, creating physically impossible perspectivas.
accuracy: Moderada - 68-78% on images with clear geometric structures
name: Análisis de Geometría Perspectiva
source: Farid (2009) - Image Forgery Detection, IEEE Signal Processing Magazine
parameters: Line detección: Progressive Probabilistic Hough Transform, Min line length: 50px, Vanishing point: RANSAC estimation, Consistency umbral: 5° angular deviation
description: Verifica geometric consistency of parallel lines, vanishing points, and depth cues. generado por IA scenes often contain perspectiva distortions that violate projective geometry rules.

references.title: Farid, H. (2009). Image Forgery Detection. IEEE Signal Processing Magazine.
Conotter, V. et al. (2014). Physiologically-Based Detection of Computer Generated Faces in Video. IEEE ICIP.

strengths:
• Based on projective geometry principles
• Effective for architectural and urban scenes
• Detecta physically impossible configurations
• Can identify subtle perspectiva errors
limitations:
• Requires images with clear linear structures
• Ineffective for natural scenes without straight lines
• Curved surfaces may create falsos positivos
• Wide-angle lens distortion complicates análisis
